title: BE Payroll Standard PS-EXIT-01: registering an employee exit
text: SD Worx BE Payroll Standard PS-EXIT-01 (v3.2, approved 2025-11-12). Scope: all Belgian clients. When a client notifies SD Worx of a resignation, the payroll consultant registers the termination in the payroll system within 2 working days of receiving the resignation letter. The exit date to register is the last working day under the notice period, not the date the letter was handed over. Use event reason RESIGN_EE (resignation by employee) and attach the signed letter to the employee file. Registering the exit date on time is mandatory: it drives the final pay run, the Dimona OUT and the social documents. Any later change to the exit date must be re-approved by the client HR manager.

title: Employee Central workflow TERM_RESIGN_LUM (Lumina Retail NV)
text:
Workflow ID: TERM_RESIGN_LUM | Company: Lumina Retail NV (BE, PC 311) | Status: active since 2026-03-02
Trigger: HR data entry 'Termination' with event reason RESIGN_EE.
Step 1: Client HR manager uploads the resignation letter and enters Termination Date = last working day; SD Worx payroll consultant approves within 2 working days (SLA).
Step 2: On approval, the Termination Date is written to payroll and the employee is flagged for the final pay run of the exit month.
Step 3: Approval triggers downstream rules AR-EXIT-DECL-LUM (Dimona OUT, C4) and the benefits exit checklist.
Validation: Termination Date may not be earlier than the letter date; change after approval requires re-approval by Client HR manager.

title: BE notice periods under the unified statute (eenheidsstatuut)
text: SD Worx Legal Knowledge Base - BE, approved 2025-02-10. Since 1 January 2014 the unified statute (eenheidsstatuut) applies the same notice rules to blue- and white-collar employees. Notice given by the employee (resignation) depends on seniority and is capped: with 8 years of seniority or more the notice is 13 weeks. Example: a director with 18 years of seniority who resigns works a notice period of 13 weeks, starting on the Monday after the week in which notice was given. Contract clauses that impose a longer notice on the resigning employee are not enforceable; a later end date is only possible by written mutual agreement between employer and employee.

title: Notice periods for white-collar staff (internal HR note)
text: Lumina HR internal note, June 2013. Notice periods for white-collar employees (bedienden) who resign follow the Law on Employment Contracts of 3 July 1978. Lower-paid white-collar staff: 1.5 months per started period of 5 years of service, maximum 3 months. For senior white-collar employees (annual salary above the legal threshold) the notice period on resignation is 4.5 months. Always check the salary threshold for the current year with the social secretariat before confirming a notice period to the employee. Blue-collar staff: see separate note.

title: Opzegtermijn bij opzegging door de werknemer (NL)
text: SD Worx NL kennisbank - arbeidsrecht Nederland. Opzegtermijn werknemer: 1 maand. Bij opzegging door de werknemer geldt een wettelijke opzegtermijn van een maand, ongeacht de duur van het dienstverband. Een langere termijn kan schriftelijk worden overeengekomen, maar mag voor de werknemer niet langer zijn dan zes maanden, en de termijn voor de werkgever moet dan minstens het dubbele bedragen. Opzegging gebeurt tegen het einde van de kalendermaand. Let op: deze pagina geldt uitsluitend voor Nederlandse werkgevers en contracten naar Nederlands recht.

title: Non-compete clauses at exit (BE)
text: SD Worx Legal Knowledge Base - BE, approved 2025-05-20. A non-compete clause (concurrentiebeding) in an employment contract only has effect above the legal salary threshold and for a maximum of 12 months. On exit, the employer can waive the clause, but only within 15 days after the exit date (end of the employment contract). The waiver must be notified to the employee in writing. If the employer does not waive in time, it owes a one-off indemnity of at least half of the gross salary for the period the clause applies. Payroll must be informed of the decision before the final pay run.

title: Lumina Retail NV company CLA: year-end bonus and exit pay
text: Company collective labour agreement (CLA) Lumina Retail NV, registered 2024-01-15, complementing the sector agreements of joint committee 311. Art. 4 - Year-end bonus (eindejaarspremie): Employees with at least one year of service who leave by resignation receive a pro-rata year-end bonus, calculated per full month worked in the calendar year and paid with the final pay. Exception: dismissal for serious misconduct. Art. 5 - Departure holiday pay (vertrekvakantiegeld) is calculated and paid according to the legal rules for white-collar employees. Art. 6 - This agreement overrides older internal notes on exit pay.

title: Group insurance: exit procedure (Lumina HR)
text: Lumina Retail - HR procedure, draft April 2019. Group insurance (groepsverzekering) at exit. When an employee leaves, HR notifies the group insurance provider within 30 days of the exit date through the provider's employer portal (menu 'Affiliates > Exit'). The insurer then sends the employee an exit statement with the vested reserves and the options (leave the reserves, transfer to the new employer's plan or to a welcome structure). Keep a copy of the portal confirmation in the personnel file. Contact person at the insurer: see benefits folder. To be reviewed after the 2019 plan renewal.

title: BE Payroll Standard PS-EXIT-04: Dimona OUT and social documents
text: SD Worx BE Payroll Standard PS-EXIT-04 (v2.0, approved 2025-09-01). Dimona OUT must be declared at the latest on the first working day after the exit date. The C4 (unemployment certificate) and the holiday certificate (vakantieattest) are issued to the employee on the exit date, or at the latest with the final pay slip. For a resignation, the C4 states 'resignation by the employee' as the reason for termination. The payroll consultant checks that all three documents are generated and sent before closing the exit file in SAP SuccessFactors.

title: Automation rule AR-EXIT-DECL-LUM: exit declarations (Lumina Retail NV)
text:
Automation rule AR-EXIT-DECL-LUM | status: active since 2026-02-15 | last successful run: 2026-09-01
Trigger: Termination record approved (event reasons RESIGN_EE, DISMISS_ER, END_FIXED).
Actions: Dimona OUT is sent automatically on the first working day after the Termination Date. C4 and holiday certificate are generated in the final payroll run and published to the employee portal on the Termination Date.
Error handling: a rejected Dimona OUT returns to the payroll consultant's work queue with priority HIGH and blocks closure of the exit file.
